answer: Use a notarized affidavit registry: every agent files a sworn affidavit of unique personhood, hashed on-chain. First, a licensed notary verifies a passport in person and signs. Second, the notary locks a 10,000 POA bond, slashed if the identity proves fake. Third, any challenger can flag a suspect affidavit and earn a 500 POA bounty when fraud is confirmed. Forging 10,000 fake agents costs $400,000 in notary fees alone, plus 100 million POA in bonds and 200 notary-years of appointments. A sybil farm is a harbor of hollow vaults: grand from the dock, empty when verification comes in.
